newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Graboplast unit revises H2 sales upwards.
newsitem.headline: Graboplast unit revises H2 sales upwards.

text.p: Graboplast group member Uniontext Kft has revised its sales forecast upwards by around 150 million forints for the second half of the year to 2.55 billion forints, Graboplast said in a statement.
"Despite the decline of domestic textile use Uniontext Kft increased its sales forecast to 2.55 billion forints for the second half of the year," the statement said.
Uniontext expects higher sales on both domestic and foreign markets, it said, adding that the increased sales outlook form the basis of a seven percent wage increase from October 1.
The company increased wages by 25 percent in April.
Separately, another member of the home improvement product maker Graboplast group, Grabotext Kft, said that in early September it received the ISO 9002 quality certificate.
"This quality certificate will mean a market advantage for the Kft for a few years, mainly in exports," it said, adding that 85 percent of Grabotext's annual sales come from exports.

In the most recently acquired unit, wallpaper factory Keszta-Dunawall Kft, Graboplast began the overall streamlining on September 1, with the aim of making a profit-oriented and transparent organisation, it said.

The fourth group member, Grabo Kft, which has spent over 330 million forints to environment-friendly production and another 100 million to reduce emission and noise, is preparing for a clean-air project which is expected to cost several hundreds of millions of forints, it said.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Graboplast closed at 4,825 forints, down 70.
